They were led by second-year head coach [[Josh Pastner]] and played their home games at [[Hank McCamish Pavilion]] as members of the [[Atlantic Coast Conference]]. They finished the season 13–19, 6–12 in ACC play to finish in 13th place. They lost in the first round of the [[2018 ACC men's basketball tournament|ACC tournament]] to [[2017–18 Boston College Eagles men's basketball team|Boston College]]. ==Previous season== The [[2016–17 Georgia Tech Yellow Jackets men's basketball team|Yellow Jackets]] finished the [[2016–17 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2016–17 season]] 21–16, 8–10 in [[2016–17 Atlantic Coast Conference men's basketball season|ACC play]] to finish in 11th place.
